spec: For every finite number x, clamp(x) returns 0 when x<=0, 10 when x>=10, and exactly x otherwise. Fractions must not be rounded.
source: export function clamp(value){if(!Number.isFinite(value))throw new TypeError('finite number required');return Math.min(10,Math.max(0,value));}
original:
import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {clamp} from '../src/clamp.js';
test('five original clamp examples',()=>{for(const [input,expected] of [[-5,0],[1,1],[5,5],[9,9],[20,10]])assert.equal(clamp(input),expected);});

defects.name: exact lower boundary off by one
defects.content: export function clamp(value){if(!Number.isFinite(value))throw new TypeError('finite number required');if(value===0)return 1;return Math.min(10,Math.max(0,value));}

defects.name: exact upper boundary off by one
defects.content: export function clamp(value){if(!Number.isFinite(value))throw new TypeError('finite number required');if(value===10)return 9;return Math.min(10,Math.max(0,value));}

defects.name: round interior fractions down
defects.content: export function clamp(value){if(!Number.isFinite(value))throw new TypeError('finite number required');if(value>0&&value<10&&!Number.isInteger(value))return Math.floor(value);return Math.min(10,Math.max(0,value));}

defects.name: negative fractional passthrough
defects.content: export function clamp(value){if(!Number.isFinite(value))throw new TypeError('finite number required');if(value<0&&value>-1)return value;return Math.min(10,Math.max(0,value));}
